in_arabic.name: Jabaa
in_arabic.long_meaning: Jabaa هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic root 'J-B-A', meaning 'to press, to be gentle, or to be compassionate'. In Islamic tradition, Jabaa is a name for those who show kindness and compassion in their actions and words.
